tools.name: list_categories
tools.description:
List product categories, optionally narrowed by ``search`` across names,
verbose names, and slugs. Pass a category's slug to ``search_products`` to
filter by it.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_products" is 2466 chars, far longer than this server's median (373). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_product" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "submit_feedback" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_product · Private data: search_products, get_product, submit_feedback · Public sink: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_product · Private data: search_products, get_product, submit_feedback · Public sink: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
